title: Brain Age Estimation Along the Continuum of Physiological Aging
official: Brain Age Estimation Along the Continuum of Physiological Aging: Development of a Multimodal Model Based on the Integration of Electroencephalography (EEG), Cognitive Performance, Lifestyle Factors, and Molecular Biomarkers
summary: To create a brain age estimation model starting from EEG, neuropsychological tests and bloood samples
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* +18 years old
* healthy

Exclusion Criteria:

* history of neurological diseases
* traumatic brain injury
* psychiatric disorders
* substance dependence
* severe sleep disturbances
